start_hint: Starts the game. You pick your fighter in the game.
native_lead: Everything OpenRecomp-FGC cannot do yet stays available there: key bindings, problem report, updates.
replays_hint: No saved replays on this PC. Use the section buttons or Back for Games.
replays_lead: Online matches land here by themselves and stay on this PC.
replay_hint: Stored on this PC. The result stays hidden until you show it.
build_running_hint: Build in progress. Steps update here; Confirm asks to cancel.
built_hint: The game is built. You only need to build again after an update.
build_hint: Builds the game from your own files. Nothing leaves this PC.
rebuild_starting: The build is starting, every step again.
rebuild_hint: Redoes every step. Hold to open confirmation; No is the default.
rebuild_lead: Redoes finished steps too. Saves are kept. Hold until the bar fills, then confirm Yes.
no_settings_hint: This game exposes no launcher settings. Use the section buttons or Back for Games.
manifest_screens: OpenRecomp-FGC builds all screens from it.
manifest_hint: A new recomp is just one entry: name, colour, sections, build or exe.
dialog_hint: No is preselected. A stray press changes nothing.
drawer_hint: Friends, lobby, key bindings and problem reports are still in the games' own launchers.
fighter_hint: Used if you do not pick in the game in time.
osk_hint: The D-pad picks the key. A real keyboard works too.
picker_files_hint: Shows only folders and matching files.
hold_hint: Hold with the pad or Enter.
no_native: This game has no launcher of its own.
no_build_here: This game is not built through OpenRecomp-FGC.
folder_hint: Show OpenRecomp-FGC where the game is.
generic_hint: Starts the file the manifest names.
t5.ready_detail: Your game runs locally on this PC. You pick your fighter in the game.
t5.rebuild_detail: This version changes the game code: build once, about 2 minutes.
t5.build_detail: Choose your package and license in the Build section.
display.hint: How the game window opens. F11 and Alt+Enter work in the game too.
display.lead: Borderless fills the screen, a window keeps the PC usable.
resolution.hint: How sharply the game is rendered.
resolution.t5_lead: Higher steps need more graphics power. Online, each player may use another step.
vsync.hint: Off: least lag, the picture may tear.
vsync.lead: Only changes how the picture reaches the screen.
effects.hint: Hit sparks, flames, smoke, mist, waterfalls.
stage_blur.hint: Soft focus and glow of some stages.
input_delay.hint: Auto picks by ping. Both players set it.
input_delay.lead: More delay means less rollback. In ranked the server sets it.
training.hint: Inputs and frame data in Practice. F2 switches in the game.
training.lead: Shows startup and advantage of every move.
practice.hint: SELECT combos, dummy and recordings in Practice.
always_left.hint: As P2 this PC shows the fight mirrored, you stand on the left.
always_left.lead: Only the picture on this PC changes.
save_replays.hint: Online matches are saved as replays on this PC.
save_replays.lead: A match takes only a few KB.
old_stages.hint: Tekken 5 stages without clearing Arcade. Your save stays as it is.
free_items.hint: All shop items free. Your save is backed up first.
package.hint: Your game package from your own account. Nothing leaves this PC.
license.hint: Your license file from your own account. Nothing leaves this PC.
responsive.hint: The build is slower, the PC stays usable.
responsive.lead: The build is slower, but the PC stays usable meanwhile.
t4.ready_detail: Tekken 4 (USA) runs natively on this PC.
resolution.t4_lead: Higher steps need more graphics power. Auto takes the step of your screen.
fullscreen.hint: F11 or Alt+Enter in the game work too.
sound.hint: The real game sound on the emulated IOP.
sound.lead: Without sound the game runs with a silent stand-in.
aa.hint: FXAA smooths the final picture; SSAA renders a larger scene.
aa.lead: Higher levels may lower fps. SMAA uses FXAA; MSAA uses supersampling.
hud.hint: Sharper HUD, menus and text above native resolution.
hud.lead: Sharp filtering keeps enlarged 2D textures clearer.
anisotropic.lead: Higher levels may lower fps. The default is 4×.
aspect.hint: 16:9 shows a wider view in fights; menus and movies stay 4:3.
aspect.lead: Only your own picture changes: you can play online against 4:3 and 16:9 players.
unlock_all.lead: All fighters from the start, without changing your save.
debug.hint: F1 in the game opens the debug window.
iso.hint: Tekken 4 USA as an ISO (SLUS-20328). No BIOS needed.
fighter.lead: After a match is found you pick in the game (30 s, Select = random). The fighter here is used if you do not pick in time.
search.hint: Log in under Online, then choose a search.
ranked.lead: Counts for your rank. Confirm your readiness after a match is found.
casual.lead: Unrated, by ping. The search runs in the T5DR launcher.
lobby.hint: The T5DR launcher with lobby, rooms, tournaments, friends and leaderboard.
lobby.lead: Rooms, tournaments, friends, spectating and leaderboard stay in the T5DR launcher.
player_name.hint: Your name for the lobby. The on-screen keyboard is enough.
player_name.lead: How you appear in the lobby.
native_hint: The {name}: controls, problem report and everything not here yet.
game_not_found: OpenRecomp-FGC did not find {name} on this PC.
search_starting: T5DR launcher is starting the search: {name}.
search_opening: T5DR launcher is opening. Start {name} there.
motion_hint: Left/right changes motion. Reduced motion makes changes instant.
dialog.stop.title: Stop this game?

dialog.rebuild.title: Rebuild every step?
dialog.rebuild.text: Finished steps run again. Saves are kept. No keeps the current build.

controls.empty: No pads found. Connect a pad and reopen this section.
controls.hint: Confirm, then press the button you want for this action. X clears it.

controls.waiting.text: Press the button you want for this action. A short tap on Back binds Back itself.
controls.waiting.hint: Waiting for a button. Hold Back for one second, or press Esc, to cancel.
controls.conflict.title: Binding conflict
controls.conflict.text: {source} is already used by {slots}. Move it to this slot?
controls.timeout: No button within 5 seconds. Confirm to try again.
controls.multi: More than one button received. Try one button at a time.
controls.disconnected: Pad disconnected. Reconnect it and reopen this section.
controls.failed: Could not bind the button. Reopen this section and try again.
controls.running: Stop the game before changing pad bindings.
controls.unsupported: This install does not provide pad binding support.
support.check.hint: Runs the installed game's checks on this PC. Nothing is sent.
support.report.hint: Creates a report archive on this PC after confirmation.
support.local_only: The report stays on this PC. You decide whether to share it.
support.not_checked: Run the check to look for known problems.
support.no_findings: No known problems found. You can create a local report for further help.
support.report.confirm.title: Create a local report?
support.report.confirm.text: The game's tool collects system details, cleaned logs and settings, and recent replay or desync data into a local ZIP. It stays on this PC; nothing is sent. Create it?
support.failed: The check or report failed: {error} Try again or use the game's launcher.
support.unavailable: This install does not provide problem checking and reporting.
support.finding.package_version.title: The package version is not supported
support.finding.package_version.fix: Choose a supported version of your own game package in Build, then build again.
support.finding.package_damaged.title: The game data may be damaged
support.finding.package_damaged.fix: Check your own package, then rebuild every step in Build. Replace an incomplete package first.
support.finding.unpack_memory.title: Unpacking ran out of memory
support.finding.unpack_memory.fix: Close other programs and try Build again. Use the game's launcher for further memory checks.
support.finding.eu_offline.title: This edition supports offline play only
support.finding.eu_offline.fix: Play offline. Use the game's launcher to check which editions support online play.
support.finding.gpu_tier1.title: The graphics card may limit performance
support.finding.gpu_tier1.fix: Lower the internal resolution and close other graphics programs. See the game's launcher for hardware guidance.
support.finding.two_cores.title: The processor may limit performance
support.finding.two_cores.fix: Close other programs while playing. See the game's launcher for processor requirements.
support.finding.wine.title: Wine or Proton was detected
support.finding.wine.fix: Check the game's launcher for compatibility instructions for Wine or Proton.
support.finding.firewall.title: The firewall may block the game
support.finding.firewall.fix: Review the game's firewall instructions in its launcher. No firewall settings were changed.
support.finding.unknown.title: The game's check found another issue
support.finding.unknown.fix: Open the game's launcher and run its problem check for the exact instructions.

t4.tools.vs2022: Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools (C++ / Windows SDK)
t4.tools.title: Build tools
t4.tools.hint: Copy the installation command, run it in a terminal and follow the installer. Restart the launcher after installation so it finds the new tools, then check again here. Both players need the same MSVC compiler version.
t4.tools.failed: The tools could not be checked. Check again.
t4.tools.vs_incomplete: C++ tools or Windows SDK missing
t4.network.title: Internet test: prepare both PCs
t4.network.firewall: On both PCs, allow inbound UDP port 7400 in Windows Firewall for your network. The port must allow both the PowerShell connection check and the built T4 runtime. A port rule can cover both; a runtime-only app rule cannot. The launcher changes no firewall rules.
t4.network.forward: For a direct internet connection, the host forwards UDP port 7400 in the router to the host PC LAN IPv4 address. The joining player enters the host public IPv4 address. With CGNAT or no router access, use Tailscale instead.
t4.network.tailscale: Install Tailscale on both PCs and connect them to the same Tailscale network. The joining player enters the host Tailscale IPv4 address (100.x.x.x). No router forwarding is needed; allow UDP 7400 in the PC firewall.
t4.network.check: Compare build ID and MSVC version. One player chooses Host, the other Join and enters the host IP. Both select Check connection at the same time. Build, compiler, ISO and two-way UDP must pass. Then both start the game. After leaving the game, collect logs here.
t4.tools.required: Some build tools are missing: choose Install missing tools on this page.
t4.tools.details_hint: The launcher checks Python, Git, CMake, Ninja and Visual Studio by itself. The versions are listed here.
t4.tools.install_hint: The build needs these tools. Install shows them first, then uses winget or verified downloads from their official vendors.
t4.tools.install_text: Windows will install: {names}. The launcher tries winget first, then verified downloads from the official vendors. Installer licence terms apply. Windows may ask for permission; Visual Studio can take a while. The tools are checked again afterwards.
t4.tools.copied_all: Commands copied. Run them in a terminal, then the launcher checks the tools again.
t4.tools.installing_hint: Installing the missing tools. Windows may ask for permission; Visual Studio can take a while.
t4.tools.install_done: Build tools installed. They are being checked again.
t4.tools.install_failed: Not every tool could be installed. Choose Install missing tools again, or copy the commands in its dialog and run them yourself.
t4.tools.no_winget: winget is unavailable. The launcher will download verified installers from the official vendors automatically.
t4.tools.work_busy: The tools cannot be installed while a check, build or game is running.
t4.source.data_outside: T4 player data needs a folder outside the source tree.
t4.source.iso_missing: The ISO file is missing or unreadable.
t4.source.iso_timeout: The ISO check took too long. Check the file and drive, then select it again.
t4.source.iso_start_failed: The ISO check could not start. Check Python and the T4 source folder.
t4.source.iso_checksum: The ELF checksum differs. Tekken 4 USA SLUS-20328 v1.00 is required.

t4.account_both_hint: One account for T5DR Online and Tekken 4: a new password works in both games at once. New recovery codes replace the old codes for both games.

other_launcher.title: Another launcher is open
other_launcher.native_t5dr: T5DR Online's own launcher is open too. You can be online in one launcher at a time: logging in here with the same account logs you out there. A game started here does not stop a search there.
other_launcher.native_t4: Tekken 4's own launcher is open too. Play in one launcher at a time: a game started there takes you out of a search here.
other_launcher.online: Another OpenRecomp window is online with this game. You can be online in one window at a time: logging in here with the same account logs you out there.
other_launcher.window: Another OpenRecomp window is open. You can be online in one window at a time: logging in here with the same account logs you out there.
other_launcher.kept_note: You play online in the other launcher. OpenRecomp stays logged out here and does not log in by itself.
other_launcher.kept_other: Logged out here: you play online in the other launcher.
other_launcher.chosen_here: OpenRecomp it is. Log in here; with the same account the other launcher is logged out.
other_launcher.kicked_native: You logged in with this account in T5DR Online's own launcher, so OpenRecomp was logged out here. You can be online in one launcher at a time. Log in here again only to play here (that logs the other one out).
other_launcher.kicked_window: You logged in with this account in another OpenRecomp window, so this window was logged out. You can be online in one window at a time. Log in here again only to play here (that logs the other one out).
other_launcher.logged_in_here: You are in the lobby. If the other launcher was logged in with this account, it is logged out now.
other_launcher.relogin_paused: The lobby connection was lost. Another launcher of this game is open, so OpenRecomp does not log in again by itself. Log in again to play here.

support.send.hint: Sends your logs to the developer. No game files, no keys, no passwords.

support.send.sending: Making the report and sending it…

support.finding.wine_graphics.title: The game's graphics did not start under Wine or Proton
support.finding.wine_graphics.fix: Try another Proton build in Steam (Proton Experimental, GE-Proton or proton-cachyos). If that does not help, install Microsoft's shader compiler into the game's prefix with protontricks d3dcompiler_47. See the game's Linux and Steam Deck help.
t4.no_powershell: Tekken 4's build and online check are PowerShell scripts, and Wine or Proton has no working PowerShell. Build the game on Windows, or install PowerShell 7 into this prefix (untested). Offline play is not affected.
netext.steady: Only opponents at a steady 60 fps
netext.search_hint: For Quick match and Ranked match. Both players’ options count. More filters can mean a longer search. Unknown Wi-Fi or speed is not excluded.
netext.feel_hint: How Auto chooses input delay: Responsive favours fast inputs; Balanced allows for the slower PC; Smooth reduces prediction. Different choices meet at Balanced.
netext.line_hint: Show ping, delay, rollbacks, connection path and fps in online matches. F3 toggles the line in the game.
netext.forget_hint: Enter your current password above. Remove your server account, profile, rating, friends, blocks and saved logins. Match results remain as “deleted player”.
netext.forget_first: Remove your account and its data from this server? Match results remain as “deleted player”. Your password will be checked before a second confirmation. This PC’s files stay.
netext.forget_review: Review the server’s counts, then confirm again to remove your account. This cannot be undone.
netext.forget_final: This cannot be undone. Remove account {name} now? {matches} match(es) and {sets} set(s) keep their results as “deleted player”; {friends} friend(s) lose you from their list.
netext.forgotten: Your account and its data were removed from the server.

t4.support.notice: Cleaned T4 logs, build identity and system facts go to the developer with your lobby name and the optional note and contact. No game files, keys or passwords.

launcher_settings.display_hint: Fullscreen or a window. Used now and every time the launcher starts.
launcher_settings.startup_hint: Opens the launcher when you sign in to Windows. Only for your user, no admin needed. Off removes it again.
launcher_settings.startup_failed: Windows did not accept the change. The setting stays as it was.
launcher_settings.prompts_hint: Which buttons the hints show. Auto follows the controller or keyboard you used last.
launcher_settings.channel_hint: Stable: tested releases only. Test versions: pre-releases for testers, for the launcher and the games.
launcher_settings.data_hint: Settings, logs and the launcher's own files live here. Games and their saves are elsewhere.
launcher_settings.open_failed: The folder could not be opened.
launcher_settings.version_hint: The launcher version. Confirm copies it, for a problem report.
launcher_settings.releases_hint: OpenRecomp-FGC on GitHub: new versions, source code and issues. Opens in your browser.
build.lead_ready_t4: Builds the game from your own files, on this PC. The first time takes about {low}-{high} minutes, later builds only seconds.
